name: experience-niho-account-status-api
deploymentNote: Consumer proposal only. Do not enable EXPERIENCE_NIHO_ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHECK_ENABLED until NIHO fixes the matching source SHA/hash and staging accepts the batch API.
scope: Batch read active, inactive, unknown, or merged status for previously connected NIHO IDs
